purpose: Replicate the unchanged v17/v32 paired contrast on ten fresh development identities before either adapting the algorithm to consumed pilot trajectories or spending the larger Spark budget.

prior_evidence.pilot_result: four Boolean Official reaches and two passes per method across eight pairs; zero discordant Official pairs
prior_evidence.use_rule: The consumed pilot may motivate measurements but does not change code, selection, or repository-specific behavior in this replication.

execution_revision_rule: Use a clean descendant containing only pilot analysis, this preregistration, metadata-only selection, and execution binding; solver, verifier, model policy, harness semantics, evaluator, and configuration hashes must remain unchanged.

host_admission.basis: Immediate continuation on the same host, image, evaluator, provider, and source boundary that completed all 16 pilot runs without infrastructure exclusion or request error.
host_admission.readmission_required_if: host, network, provider model, evaluator revision or image identity changes, or any frozen source/configuration hash changes before selection

matched_primitive_limits.matching_basis: primitive limits; USD is operational metadata only

outcomes: scientifically eligible run and pair counts
paired Boolean Official reach and pass
negative-operation admissions, subsequent exposure, and guard rejections
candidate failure decomposition by observation, constraint, and operation layer
model requests, tokens, fresh environments, commands, and wall-clock time

predeclared_decision.complete_unchanged_replication: Run all ten pairs unless a shared boundary invariant fails or the operator interrupts execution.
predeclared_decision.support_larger_unchanged_batch: At least one EnvSolve-only Boolean Official pass or reach, no baseline-only pass, no unexplained paired terminal regression, and at least six eligible Boolean Official pairs in the replication.
predeclared_decision.pause_for_algorithm_review: No positive Official discordance across the ten replication pairs, or continued zero guard rejection despite grounded negative-operation facts, triggers aggregate consumed-trajectory review before larger execution.
predeclared_decision.halt_for_regression: Any baseline-only Official pass or unexplained baseline-only terminal reach pauses execution planning for paired error analysis.
predeclared_decision.insufficient_terminal_reach: Fewer than six eligible Boolean Official pairs supports mechanism and failure decomposition only, not an effectiveness estimate.

execution_rule.zero_information_pre_episode_failure: One audited same-identity retry only when model, candidate, environment, command, evaluator, and method information are all zero.
execution_rule.partial_process_interruption: Mark the position scientifically ineligible without overwrite or rerun.
execution_rule.terminal_evaluator_infrastructure_failur: One evaluator-only retry of the identical script with zero new model calls.
execution_rule.other_infrastructure_failure: Record Unknown and censor the pair without replacement.
